about.title: About us
about.p1: Paper Planes (Hartieni Samoleti) is a small studio for original goods: tote bags, cards, bookmarks, notebooks and gift sets.
about.p2: Every drawing and every caption is made with a smile. Ducks on holiday, cats with opinions and owls who know everything. We want every item to be a small reason to be happy, light as a paper plane. The captions on the products are in Bulgarian.
about.follow: Follow us on social media, that is where new things appear first:
